description: Industry landing pages — organized by buyer's industry, not by product category

industries.title: Mining Industry Supply Solutions
industries.buyer_pain_point: Mining operations in remote locations need reliable spare parts supply. Equipment downtime costs thousands per hour. OEM parts have long lead times and premium pricing. Alternative quality suppliers are essential for maintaining fleet availability.
sourcing_priorities: Bearing and seal kits for crushers and mills
Compressor service parts for mine ventilation
Slurry pump wear parts and impellers
Dust collector filter bags and cartridges

industries.title: Oil & Gas Industry Supply Solutions
industries.buyer_pain_point: Oil and gas facilities require certified components that meet API, ASME, and ATEX standards. Equipment operates in harsh environments. Supply chain reliability and material traceability are non-negotiable.

industries.title: Manufacturing Industry Supply Solutions
industries.buyer_pain_point: Factory production lines depend on automation, pneumatics, and mechanical systems. Production downtime from component failure directly impacts output. Alternative spare parts suppliers reduce single-source dependency and maintenance costs.
sourcing_priorities: Bearing replacements for motors and spindles

industries.title: Construction Equipment Supply Solutions
industries.buyer_pain_point: Construction equipment operates under heavy loads in dusty environments. Hydraulic systems, undercarriage parts, and engine components wear quickly. Reliable alternative parts suppliers keep equipment fleets working.
sourcing_priorities: Travel motor and swing motor parts
Filter elements for engine and hydraulic oil
Water pump and oil pump replacements

industries.title: Water Treatment Industry Supply Solutions
industries.buyer_pain_point: Water and wastewater treatment plants operate 24/7. Pump failures, valve leaks, and filter clogging cause treatment interruptions. Reliable spare parts at reasonable cost are essential for continuous operation.
